name: ecommerce-storefront
description: Northline, an online shop for outdoor gear, front and back: an open-source example app for Adminium.

scripts.build:surface:customer: VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=customer tsc -b && VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=customer vite build --base=/apps/ecommerce-shop/customer/ --outDir dist-surface/ecommerce-shop/customer
scripts.build:surface:staff: VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=staff tsc -b && VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=staff vite build --base=/apps/ecommerce-shop/staff/ --outDir dist-surface/ecommerce-shop/staff
scripts.build:surface: npm run build:surface:staff && npm run build:surface:customer
